purpose: Reproduce the HCA corporate-structure diagram only, using simulated entity names, hypothetical ownership stakes and illustrative guarantor markings. This file is a single-company example of the reusable onboarding JSON format; no debt tables or lender commentary.
simulation_disclaimer: THIS HCA ORGANISATION CHART IS A SIMULATED EDUCATIONAL EXAMPLE. Listed legal entities, ownership percentages, borrower designation and guarantor assignments are hypothetical and must not be described as HCA Healthcare’s verified actual corporate structure.
how_to_use: This file contains one case only: companies.HCA. Other companies must be supplied through their own separate single-company corporate-structure JSON files using this same schema.
Select the sole company entry and draw the structure from its nodes, ownership_links and visual_spec; do not infer or invent missing nodes or relationships.
Use display_name exactly, including punctuation and capitalization, and show role below each company name.
Render percentage labels only from ownership_links, and never infer unstated ownership.
Draw a shield when and only when is_guarantor=true.
Draw only the corporate structure, title, subtitle, legend and simulation footnote. No debt table, financial analysis, proposed loan, bank branding or other panels.
If the rendering system does not support precise pixel positioning, preserve hierarchy, left-to-right sibling order, node grouping, percentage labels and shield markers.
Never use this example unless it has been explicitly uploaded or associated with the current HCA analysis case; do not use it to infer any other company structure.

node_style.name_wrapping: Wrap long names into 2-3 centered lines within their rectangle. Reduce size to 15 px only when needed to prevent overflow.
node_style.role_name_override: If role is Parent / Borrower, show (Parent / Borrower) exactly.

ownership_links_style.style: black orthogonal (right-angle) connector from bottom center of parent node to top center of child node
ownership_links_style.sibling_grouping: For multiple children, draw one horizontal bus per parent with individual vertical drops to each child; all drops attach to the same parent.
ownership_links_style.bus_y_rule: Bus lies approximately midway between the parent bottom and child top; do not overlap any node.

percentage_label.location: beside child-specific vertical drop, above child box

ownership_links_style.avoid: Crossed lines, arrowheads, percent labels disconnected from their links, ambiguous step-parent relationships.
ownership_links_style.single_child_rule: If a parent has exactly one child, do not draw a horizontal bus. Draw one perfectly straight vertical connector from the parent bottom center to the child top center, with no elbow, no jog and no lateral offset.
ownership_links_style.single_child_alignment_rule: For any one-to-one parent-child relationship, the child node center_x_px must equal the parent node center_x_px. If supplied coordinates differ slightly, snap the child to the parent centerline.
ownership_links_style.bus_exception_rule: Use a horizontal bus only when a parent has two or more children.

footer.text: Illustrative only — simulated legal entities, ownership stakes and guarantor assignments; not actual corporate information.

negative_requirements: No JPMorgan or any other bank name.
No loan arrows or proposed-loan callouts.
No credit commentary or bottom callout panels.
No financial metrics, data tables, or invented numbers.
No spell-check underlines or image watermarks.
No extra header disclaimer line below the subtitle.
No legend footnote or legend note outside the listed legend entries.
For single-child relationships, no bent, stepped or diagonal-looking connectors.

revision_notes: Reduced original four-company refined file to companies.HCA only; preserved HCA nodes, ownership links, per-node coordinates, roles, guarantor flags and full visual_spec.
Removed the non-essential header disclaimer and legend note as in the refined source.
Specified straight vertical connectors for parent-child pairs where a parent has only one child.
